propositions: Jira workflows forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g., open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and ticket to drift.
The transport raises RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError when a direct transition is illegal, which today triggers comment-fallback instead of retrying.
Replay mechanism uses recorded STATUS events (append-only, chronologically ordered) to extract intermediate hops in Jira-name space and re-attempt via allowed intermediate transitions.
Resume point is determined by matching the current Jira issue status name to the recorded hop sequence, without inverting LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA, anchoring on the last positional match.
Replay calls transition_issue_by_name once per remaining hop in order; any hop raising RuntimeError, ValueError, or HTTPError aborts replay and falls back to comment-fallback + drift.

Signature of _update_one_scalar_update is widened to accept local_id parameter; exception handling is widened to catch the union of transport failures and call replay_transition before comment-fallback.
